alt: Tesla Cybercab parked at Santana Row, photographed from the side showing the sleek two-door autonomous robotaxi body with its distinctive butterfly door design and no steering wheel visible through the windscreen
story: Tesla's Cybercab robotaxi, which launched paid rides in Austin in September 2026, has automatic butterfly doors that open without stopping when someone stands in their blind spot, so the car will cheerfully bump a bystander on its way to being helpful.
why_funny: An autonomous vehicle whose entire pitch is 'we removed the human error' solved the door problem by removing the human — and the door-won't-hit-you part.
